title: Polish your CV
recap: Pipo wrote the highlights for your CV.
funFact: Agents can write job emails for you, too. Next, Pipo emails Bloom Café!
postcard: a student proudly holding a neat CV outside Bloom Café: {answer}
situation: Bloom Café is hiring a barista! Want me to polish your CV?
facts: ☕ A barista job at Bloom Café
🥫 1 year volunteering at the food bank
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on a university student's phone. Help with what they ask. When you write CV highlights, write short bullet lines about the person.

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: CV highlights for a barista job at Bloom Café
pieces.text: Write the highlights for my CV for a barista job at Bloom Café.

slots.label: What does Pipo need to know?

pieces.label: 1 year volunteering at the food bank
pieces.text: I volunteered at the food bank for a year.

pieces.label: Say I'm a world-class barista!
pieces.tip: Made-up skills fall apart in the interview. Real experience, told well, is enough.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo about your volunteering.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know about the food bank, so your best experience is missing.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo you speak Spanish.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know you speak Spanish, so the CV leaves it out.

flaws.hint: "Make my CV better" doesn't say which job it's for.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know the job, so the CV isn't aimed at a barista role.

lesson: Tell Pipo the job and your real experience. Honest and specific beats impressive.
